raw_output: Answer: Sarah's approach to managing personal and work-related stress has evolved significantly over time, particularly in relation to her romantic relationships. Initially, she struggled with anxiety and vulnerability in the workplace, but through therapy, she learned to set boundaries and be more open about her feelings. As she entered a new relationship, she was concerned about how colleagues might react, but she and her partner agreed to keep things professional. With time, Sarah became more confident in her ability to balance work and personal life, finding healthy outlets like yoga and reading to manage stress. She also learned to prioritize self-care and set limits to maintain her well-being. In her relationship, Sarah has made a conscious effort to communicate openly and avoid falling back into old patterns, seeking to maintain a strong foundation of trust and understanding.
